name: Silver Glint
description: Flash a glint of soul at a target and read the soul that glints back.

name: Cast Mood
description: Hold a target's mood in the user's own soul like a face held in still water.

name: Glass Hush
description: Polish the mind to a mirror finish so that a hostile touch shows its sender only itself.

name: Twinned Mirror
description: Set a second mirror in one ally's mind so that the ally's sensing copies the user's.

name: Silvered Read
description: Read a target's soul in silvered detail down to its smallest habits.

name: Silver Wipe
description: Wipe a clinging soul taint from one ally as dust is wiped from glass.

name: Facing Mirrors
description: Turn two mirrors of soul upon each other so that each reads past the other into depths no single glance could reach.

name: Return Shard
description: Shatter the mirror guard at the instant of a hostile touch and fling the shards back at the sender.

name: Borrowed Sight
description: Throw the user's soul into a target's and see through the target's own senses for a few breaths.

name: Blue Ken
description: Look far across clear air with the soul and read the souls at the edge of sight.

name: High Reach
description: Lift the sensing soul to a great height where the air runs thin and the view runs wide.

name: Thin Air
description: Thin the user's soul to near nothing so that a far probe slides through unmarked.

name: Lens Tune
description: Tune the soul like a lens to bring a faint far shape into sharp focus.

name: Far Count
description: Count the souls in a distant company and tell how many carry weapons in their spirit.

name: Sky Weave
description: Weave the user's far sight into each ally's mind so that all see the same distant ground.

name: Distance Mend
description: Reach across a great gap to cleanse a far ally's soul of an ill touch.

name: Reach Beyond
description: Reach past the edge of sight and read a far city's souls as a single map.

name: Distant Lance
description: Send a long narrow lance of soul across a great gap to pierce one foe's guard of mind.

name: Whole Sky Ken
description: Spread the soul over the whole sky above a land and read every soul that lives beneath it.

name: Falcon Gaze
description: Watch from a high still point and note each soul that enters the basin below.

name: Brim Gather
description: Gather the scattered feelings of a place into the basin of the mind.

name: Perch Guard
description: Perch the mind on a high still point where grasping touches cannot climb.

name: Dive Mark
description: Dive on a single soul in the basin and mark it so it can be found again.

name: Dread Drain
description: Drain standing dread from one ally's soul as water is drained from a basin.

name: Updraft Lend
description: Lend the hawk's lift to one ally so that the ally's sensing rises above the press.

name: Brim Gaze
description: Watch every soul brimming in the basin and name the one about to spill over into action.

name: Talon Seize
description: Close the talons of the high gaze round one foe's will and hold it fast.

name: Stooping Verdict
description: Fall on one marked soul from a great height with all the gathered sensing behind a single piercing stroke.

name: Twinned Hearts
description: Hear the beat of two hearts at once and tell which is the stronger.

name: Beat Match
description: Match the user's pulse to one ally's so that both sense as one.

name: Twin Hush
description: Hush two minds together under one shared guard so that neither stands alone.

name: Quick Second
description: Feel the quick second beat that comes in a soul just before a strike.

name: Chord Read
description: Read the chord that two bound souls make and learn what binds them.

name: Rift Mend
description: Mend a rift of dread between two allies so that their beats fall in step again.

name: Joined Pulse
description: Share one pulse among a handful of allies so that they act as a single body.

name: Hearing Deep
description: Hear the hearts of an entire hall as one drum and pick out the one beat that is off.

name: Break Beat
description: Strike an off beat into two bonded foes so that their shared rhythm falls apart.

name: Heart Chorus
description: Raise every ally's heart into one chorus so that each feels the others' pain and strength and acts in accord.

name: Dual Judge
description: Hold two separate readings of one soul side by side and compare them.

name: Counsel Quiet
description: Quiet the first mind so that the second can speak plainly to it.

name: Bench Hush
description: Hold a grave hush round the mind so that no hostile pressure can raise its voice there.

name: Plea Weigh
description: Weigh the sincerity of a plea by the soul that makes it.

name: Verdict Calm
description: Lift a rage or a terror from one ally's soul so that the ally can think and judge again.

name: Second Mind
description: Open a second mind in the user that watches for what the first has missed.

name: Open Session
description: Convene every sense of the soul at once and judge all the souls present in a single sitting.

name: Ruling Hold
description: Hold a whole room in the quiet of a ruling so that no soul in it can act in haste.

name: Dual Verdict
description: Pass a double judgment on one soul and read its past deeds and its next moves in the same breath.

name: Level Ear
description: Listen across open flat ground where no soul can hide behind a rise.

name: Gust Hark
description: Catch the passing gust of a soul's intent before it settles into action.

name: Brace Mind
description: Lean the mind into a hard soul wind and let it break against a firm stance.

name: Lingering Listen
description: Listen for hours across a wide ground and log every soul that comes and goes.

name: Wind Lend
description: Lend a steady wind of sensing to one ally so that the ally hears as far as the user.

name: Gale Bath
description: Blow a hard clean gale through one ally's soul to scour away a clinging taint.

name: Wide Hearing
description: Hear every soul across a broad open ground and tell its mood and its distance at once.

name: Severing Gust
description: Drive a cutting gust of soul force across the ground to stagger every foe in its path.

name: Windsworn Ken
description: Swear the whole sensing soul to the wind and read every soul the wind has touched for a great distance.

name: Sworn Eye
description: Fix a sworn watching eye of soul on those in the user's charge and mark their well being.

name: Sleepless Ken
description: Keep the sensing soul awake while the body rests so that no danger passes unfelt.

name: Charge Count
description: Count those in the user's care and learn at once if any is missing or hurt.

name: Vigil Mantle
description: Wear the oath of the watcher as a mantle of soul that turns aside minds meant to lull the user.

name: Danger Ring
description: Draw a ring of watchful soul about the charge and feel anything hostile that nears it.

name: Watcher Rest
description: Lift the deep weariness of a long watch from one ally so that the ally's mind runs clear.

name: Charge Bond
description: Bind the senses of the charge to the watcher's so that a cry from one is heard by all.

name: Whole Charge
description: Hold every soul in the user's charge in mind at once and feel any that wavers.

name: Charge Shield
description: Spread the watcher's guard over every ally in reach so that all share its protection.

name: Unsleeping Oath
description: Swear the watch aloud so that every ally in hearing is lifted past fatigue and fear for the span of one fight.

name: Blind Bearing
description: Take a bearing on a soul with the eyes shut and the senses dark.

name: Feeling Thread
description: Draw a straight line of feeling from the user to a chosen soul and follow it.

name: Unseen Guard
description: Guard the user against what cannot be seen by feeling for the soul behind each blow.

name: Steer True
description: Steer one ally by the user's bearing so that the ally moves surely through thick dark.

name: Company Fix
description: Fix a bearing on each member of a company so that all stay found in a chaotic fight.

name: Direction Mend
description: Mend the lost sense of direction in an ally whose senses have been scrambled by a soul trick.

name: Dead Reckon
description: Reckon the whole course of a hidden foe from the weight of its trail and name where it will stand next.

name: Course Thrust
description: Strike along a held bearing to reach a foe who cannot be seen.

name: Soul Compass
description: Turn the whole sensing soul into a compass that points to every soul the user has ever marked.

name: Wind Ken
description: Let the sensing soul ride a light wind and read what the wind passes.

name: Rising Ken
description: Ride a rising gust to a greater height and a wider view.

name: Carry Back
description: Draw the sensing soul home on a returning wind carrying everything it met.

name: Windless Guard
description: Fall into a dead calm that no hostile soul wind can stir.

name: Far Wind
description: Send the soul on a long wind to a far place and keep a thread of it home.

name: Wind Tally
description: Count every soul that the wind has touched in the last hour.

name: Gust Clear
description: Blow the lingering fog of a soul curse out of one ally on a clean gust.

name: Gale Ken
description: Drive the sensing soul on a gale that carries it across a whole region and back.

name: Wind Sever
description: Sever a foe's sensing soul from its tether with a single cutting wind.

name: Skyborne Ken
description: Carry the whole sensing soul up on the high wind and read every soul across a great expanse as one living map.

name: Cry Hark
description: Listen for any cry of pain or fear that rises from a soul in reach.

name: Distress Mark
description: Mark the exact place where a soul is crying for help.

name: Ear Guard
description: Guard the open ear of the soul so that a cry that is a lure cannot pull it astray.

name: Cry Reach
description: Reach out along a cry to find its source through crowd and wreckage.

name: Aid Call
description: Call to nearby allies along their souls so that all turn toward a fallen friend.

name: Hurt Draw
description: Draw the sharp pain of a wounded ally's soul into the user so that the ally can stand.

name: Rescue Sense
description: Feel for every soul trapped or buried across a ruined ground and mark which still burn.

name: Recalled Breath
description: Pull back the soul of an ally whose breath has just stopped and hold it to the body until the breath returns.

name: Answering Oath
description: Swear to answer every cry within reach so that the user's soul and strength rise with each call.
